title: 中式快餐四巨头②兰州牛肉面：一碗面，能拉出九种粗细 | China's Fast-Food Giants P2 · Lanzhou 🍜
description:
点单时刻——你是毛细党，还是二细党？ / Order time: are you team hair-thin, or team second-thin?

第②集·兰州牛肉面 —— 「中式快餐四巨头」系列，每天一个打工人午餐的国民品牌。
P2 · Lanzhou Beef Noodles — from the series China's Fast-Food Giants: one everyday lunch legend a day.

一碗面，靠五个字火遍全国：一清、二白、三红、四绿、五黄——汤要清、萝卜要白、辣油要红、香菜蒜苗要绿、面条要黄亮，缺一样都不算正宗。传说1915年，回族厨师马保子在兰州创出这碗牛肉面，立下了这套标准。最见功夫的是拉面：师傅手上一抖，一团面就能拉出毛细、细、二细、三细、韭叶、宽、大宽等近十种粗细，你只要报一句，师傅就给你拉哪种。要注意——兰州人只管它叫「牛肉面」，不叫「兰州拉面」，这是规矩。2021年，兰州牛肉面制作技艺入选国家级非物质文化遗产。
One bowl of noodles conquered China with five words: clear, white, red, green, yellow — the broth clear, the radish white, the chili oil red, the herbs green, the noodles bright yellow; miss one and it isn't authentic. As the story goes, in 1915 the Hui chef Ma Baozi created this beef-noodle bowl in Lanzhou and set the standard. The real craft is the pulling: with a flick of the wrist, one lump of dough becomes nearly ten widths — hair-thin, thin, second, third, leek-leaf, wide, extra-wide — you just call it out and the master pulls it. Note this: locals call it "beef noodles," never "Lanzhou lamian" — that's the rule. In 2021, the craft was listed as national intangible cultural heritage.
